title: Back Up Before You Regret: Measuring Backup Awareness and Automating Backup in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.28934v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents now complete tasks autonomously, modifying real-world state such as artifacts, software environments, and configurations along the way. Yet they show limited backup awareness: recognizing that an action will modify state that may later be needed, and preserving it beforehand. To evaluate backup awareness, we introduce RegretBench, a benchmark of 205 executable tasks grounded in regret moments reported on platforms such as X.com, GitHub, and Stack Overflow, where users explicitly regretted not preserving state they later needed. Across six frontier models, agents complete 86.1% of tasks on average yet back up before these moments in only 15.2%, showing that task completion ability does not imply backup awareness. Because it is hard to predict which changes will be regretted, we propose BackUpper, a harness plug-in backup layer that checks every tool call and preserves affected state before modification. translated_title: 先备份，免后悔：测量编码智能体的备份意识并实现备份自动化
translated_abstract: 编码智能体现在能够自主完成任务，并在此过程中修改工件、软件环境与配置等真实世界的状态。然而，它们表现出有限的备份意识——即识别某项操作将修改日后可能需要的状态并提前予以保存的能力。为了评估备份意识，我们提出了 RegretBench，一个包含 205 个可执行任务的基准，这些任务源自 X.com、GitHub 和 Stack Overflow 等平台上用户明确表示后悔未保存后续所需状态的“后悔时刻”。在六个前沿模型上，智能体平均完成 86.1% 的任务，但在这些时刻之前进行备份的比例仅为 15.2%，这表明任务完成能力并不意味着具备备份意识。由于难以预测哪些更改日后会被后悔，我们提出了 BackUpper——一个以测试框架插件形式存在的备份层，它检查每一次工具调用，并在修改之前保存受影响的状态。它结合了基于规则的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 RegretBench 基准，揭示编码智能体虽平均完成 86.1% 的任务、却仅在 15.2% 的“后悔时刻”前主动备份，并据此推出 BackUpper 插件，在每次修改状态的工具调用之前自动保存受影响的状态，从而实现备份自动化。
